note.zh-TW: 會員權益在台北與新北的 CITYLINK 購物中心現場使用；App 在台灣以外是否可下載、註冊未確認。
note.en: Benefits are used in person at CITYLINK shopping centers in Taipei and New Taipei; whether the app can be installed or used outside Taiwan was not checked.

label.zh-TW: CITYLINK 官網：會員權益說明
CITYLINK 官網：會員服務條款

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」：本站會複製邀請碼 6UID，並開啟 CITYLINK 官網的會員專區頁面。
steps.en: Select “Sign up”: this site copies invite code 6UID and opens the member page on the official CITYLINK website.

steps.zh-TW: 從該頁面的 App Store 或 Google Play 連結下載並開啟 CITYLINK App。
steps.en: Download and open the CITYLINK app from the App Store or Google Play links on that page.

steps.zh-TW: 依畫面指示完成註冊，並在要求邀請碼的地方貼上 6UID，也可依原樣（含大小寫）手動輸入；欄位的確切位置本站未確認。
steps.en: Register as directed; paste 6UID where an invite code is requested, or type it as shown (case-sensitive). This site has not confirmed where the field is.

steps.zh-TW: 回饋內容與領取方式請以 CITYLINK 官方公告為準；分享文案沒有說明具體回饋。
steps.en: Rewards and how to claim them follow CITYLINK’s official announcements; the share text states no concrete reward.

intro.zh-TW: CITYLINK 購物中心的會員 App：下載後依指示輸入邀請碼 6UID。
intro.en: Download CITYLINK, the member app of the CITYLINK shopping centers, and enter invite code 6UID.

description.zh-TW:
CITYLINK 是台北與新北的購物中心品牌；CITYLINK App 依 App Store 說明是各分店通用的會員 App，提供行動會員註冊、會員專區（積點、消費紀錄、停車折扣、贈品兌換）與活動消息，可免費下載。

本站的連結不含邀請碼，分享文案也只提供 App 商店連結：點擊「立即註冊」時，本站會複製邀請碼 6UID，並開啟 CITYLINK 官網的會員專區頁面，頁面上有 App Store 與 Google Play 的下載連結。下載並開啟 App 後，依畫面指示貼上或手動輸入邀請碼（請依原樣，含大小寫）。

分享文案只寫「和我一起推薦好友拿好禮」，沒有說明具體回饋，所以本頁不列出優惠。實際內容以 CITYLINK 官方公告為準。
description.en:
CITYLINK is a brand of shopping centers in Taipei and New Taipei. Its App Store listing describes the CITYLINK app as the member app for all branches, offering mobile membership sign-up, a member area (points, purchase history, parking discounts, gift redemption) and promotion news. It is free to download.

The link on this page does not carry the invite code, and the share text only gave app store links: selecting “Sign up” copies code 6UID and opens the member page on the official CITYLINK website, which has App Store and Google Play download links. After you install and open the app, paste the code or type it in as the screens direct, exactly as shown, including capitalization.

The share text only says to recommend friends together with the sender to get gifts and states no concrete reward, so no offer is listed here. Actual terms follow CITYLINK’s official announcements.

notes.zh-TW:
邀請碼 6UID 不在連結中，註冊時需貼上或手動輸入（請依原樣，含大小寫）。分享文案只提供 App 商店連結，沒有個人專屬連結，所以「立即註冊」開啟的是 CITYLINK 官網的會員專區頁面；維運者 2026-10-24 開啟該頁，標題為「會員專區，手機就是你的會員卡」。App 下載連結：[App Store](https://apps.apple.com/tw/app/citylink/id945674268)、[Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.linkwish.citylink)；Google Play 頁面未能讀取，但官網連結同一個套件。

CITYLINK 官網的會員專區、會員權益說明、會員服務條款與 App Store 頁面都沒有提到邀請碼；官網另有推薦好友類的活動（2026-09-25 至 2026-12-06），說明內容是圖片，無法確認是否與這組邀請碼有關。本站未註冊，邀請碼是否被接受、輸入欄位在哪個畫面都未經測試。

依官方會員服務條款，未滿 20 歲，或依法需經第三人同意者，註冊前須取得家長或法定代理人同意。積點不能兌換現金或轉讓，CITYLINK 也可能調整或取消權益。
notes.en:
Invite code 6UID is not in the link, so it must be pasted or typed in during registration (enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization). The share text only gave app store links and no personal link, so “Sign up” opens the member page on the official CITYLINK website; the maintainer opened that page on 2026-10-24, and its title reads “會員專區，手機就是你的會員卡” (member area, your phone is your member card). App download links: [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/tw/app/citylink/id945674268) and [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.linkwish.citylink); the Google Play page could not be read, but the official site links the same package.

CITYLINK’s member page, membership benefits page, membership terms and App Store listing do not mention an invite code. The official site also shows campaigns about recommending friends (2026-09-25 to 2026-12-06), but their details are images, so this site cannot confirm whether they relate to this code. This site has not registered an account, so whether the code is accepted and on which screen it is entered were not tested.

Under the official membership terms, anyone under 20, or who needs third-party consent under ROC law, must get parent or guardian consent before registering. Per the membership benefits page, points cannot be redeemed for cash or transferred, and CITYLINK may adjust or remove benefits.

q.zh-TW: CITYLINK 的邀請碼是多少？怎麼輸入？
q.en: What is the CITYLINK invite code and how do I enter it?

a.zh-TW: 邀請碼是 6UID。本站的連結不含邀請碼，點擊「立即註冊」時會先複製它，再開啟 CITYLINK 官網的會員專區頁面；下載並開啟 App 後，依畫面指示貼上，或依原樣（含大小寫）手動輸入。本站未註冊，邀請碼是否被接受未經測試。
a.en: The invite code is 6UID. The link on this page does not carry it: selecting “Sign up” copies the code first and then opens the member page on the official CITYLINK website. After installing and opening the app, paste the code as the screens direct, or type it exactly as shown, including capitalization. This site has not registered an account, so whether the code is accepted was not tested.

q.zh-TW: 使用 CITYLINK 邀請碼有什麼回饋？
q.en: What reward does the CITYLINK invite code give?

a.zh-TW: 分享文案只寫「和我一起推薦好友拿好禮」，沒有說明具體回饋與由誰領取，本站也沒有在 CITYLINK 官方網頁找到邀請碼的說明，所以本頁不列出優惠。實際內容以 CITYLINK 官方公告為準。
a.en: The share text only invites you to recommend friends together with the sender to get gifts. It does not state a concrete reward or who receives it, and no explanation of the invite code was found on CITYLINK’s official web pages, so no offer is listed on this page. Actual terms follow CITYLINK’s official announcements.
